overall_assessment: All 28 courses were reviewed: the 12 random controls preserve structured plan content, with no demonstrated omitted on-page prose or wrong academic-year selection. Of the 16 suspects, 15 are facts-only source pages whose uncaptured text contains only year-picker options, so their short flags do not establish extraction loss; the remaining short/dup_code suspect is a generic error page accepted as plan text. Minor history/timetable navigation survives widely; linked external reading lists, packet truncation markers, and apparent source punctuation or stale prose do not establish additional extraction defects.

findings.description: All 27 course-specific extracts retain the standalone history-navigation label Emnehistorikk, and five random controls also retain Timeplan with semester link labels. These interface labels are not plan prose, despite the absence of a pre-pass junk flag. The facts box and substantive sections remain readable; a Pensum link alone does not demonstrate missing on-page literature.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/institution_config.R selects all of #main-content and excludes only h2.portlet-title-text. The header and section.section-top are marked as facts, but page_fulltext() includes facts by default, so this marking does not remove history and timetable navigation.
findings.suggested_fix: In an OsloMet-only post_fn, restrict cleanup to the header before the first substantive plan heading: remove lines exactly equal to Emnehistorikk, and remove a line exactly equal to Timeplan together with its immediately following lines matching ^(?:HØST|VÅR) [0-9]{4}$. Preserve the course title, English title, credits, Studieår value, programme associations, and substantive reading-list or plan text.
